messages:
Maya R: Heads up — planning to roll the feature flag `enable_shared_prefix_cache` to 100% in prod tonight at 23:00 UTC. Plan: 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 5–10 min observation between steps. Who can own the flip and run the smoke checks? Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/flag-rollouts :eyes:

Arjun S: I can take the flip. I'll be online from 22:45 UTC and will execute the steps. Confirming rollback command and canary sizes? Also want to know any dependent toggles to hold during the flip.

Maya R: thanks @Arjun S. Canary plan: 20% for 10m, 50% for 10m, then 100%. Safe-defaults flag (`shared_prefix_safe_default`) is ON so new requests should fallback gracefully. Dependent: do NOT change `per_tenant_batching` or `kv_prefetch_v2` during window.

Priya K: I'll run the smoke script and watch SLO dashboards + errors. Smoke checklist I'll run after each step: 1) basic gen latency <200ms p50 2) error rate <0.1% 3) no spike in tail latency or OOMs 4) sampler queries pass. I'll post results here.

Casey L: quick note — the rollout touches EU and US pools. Arjun, when flipping, pick region flag sequence: US then EU (to be safe). Also check tenant routing metrics for heavy customers.

Arjun S: understood. I'll flip US canary first. Rolling commands I'll use the feature-service API:
```
# set to 20%
curl -X POST https://features.redwood/api/flags/enable_shared_prefix_cache/override -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" -d '{"percent":20, "scope":"prod:us"}'
```
Rollback command (if we see regressions):
```
# set back to 0% (safe-defaults remain)
curl -X POST https://features.redwood/api/flags/enable_shared_prefix_cache/override -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN" -d '{"percent":0, "scope":"prod:*"}'
```
I'll also tag the change in the flags audit and link the change id here.

sre-bot: Reminder: scheduled quiet window 22:30-00:30 UTC. Pager rotations: oncall=Arjun S, backup=Casey L. Please follow rollback runbook if error rate > 0.2% or latency p95 > baseline + 200ms.

Priya K: smoke script (one-liner) I'll run after each bump:
```
python infra/tools/smoke_check.py --env prod --region us --queries 200 --threshold-latency 200
```
I'll paste the results as quick bullets after each stage.

Casey L: If anything odd, I can cut traffic to a lower-tier capacity pool or flip the tenant-scoped flag. Also ensure autoscaler hasn't been paused.

Maya R: small list of metrics to watch in Console: token/sec per model, p50/p95 gen latency, error count, KV cache miss rate, GPU mem pressure, and top 10 tenants by latency. If all green after 30m at 100% we consider it done.

Arjun S: I'll post the audit ID and timestamps as I step through. Plan start 23:00 UTC, US 20% -> wait -> 50% -> EU 50% -> global 100% by ~23:25 if green. I'll @casey on rollback.

Priya K: Roger. I'll be ready to escalate to rollback within 5m of any red flags. I'll also capture traces and link them here.

Maya R: thanks team. Please update this thread when you start each stage ("US 20% started", "US 20% OK", etc.). If Arjun needs to handoff mid-run, Casey will take over. :thumbsup:

Arjun S: Copy. Will start at 23:00 UTC and post step messages.
